name: host font eval
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && nix eval --impure --json --expr 'let c = (builtins.getFlake "git+file:///home/davr/.config/dendritic").nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.fonts.packages; in builtins.length c' 2>&1 | tail -3 && nix eval --impure --json --expr 'let c = (builtins.getFlake "git+file:///home/davr/.config/dendritic").nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.fonts.packages; in builtins.filter (n: builtins.match ".*(oswald|jetbrains-mono|orbitron|source-serif).*" n != null) (builtins.map (p: p.name) c)' 2>&1 | tail -2
